jobs.desc: Executive operations leadership role with a large, established Arizona catering and events group. This position reports to the President and owns operational performance across three business units: full service catering operations, a warehouse, facilities, and fleet function, and food and beverage operations at a major regional event venue with city and event producer relationships. Direct reports include two general managers and a warehouse and facilities manager. The role sets expectations, builds accountability and operating rhythm, develops the leadership bench, drives SOP consistency and service quality across every event type, and manages departmental budgets, labor strategy, KPIs, and capital planning in partnership with Culinary, Sales, Finance, and People Operations. Requires 10 plus years of progressive leadership in catering, hospitality, or large scale operations with proven multi unit or multi site experience, deep knowledge of high volume food production and supply chain, strong financial management, and comfort championing new systems and technology. Frequent evenings, weekends, and extended hours based on event schedules. The people we seek for this role describe themselves as structured, accountable leaders who develop managers, bring discipline to complex logistics, and stay composed and decisive through peak event periods.

Premier residential community with a full dining program and an elevated, hospitality first culture. We seek a polished food and beverage leader who builds great teams and lasting resident relationships.
